info.title: Project & Task Management API
info.description: Token-based HTTP API for teams, projects, tasks, labels, comments, attachments, notifications, activity, search and dashboards. Clients register or log in to obtain an API token and present it as a Bearer token on subsequent requests.

servers.description: API root (all routes are registered under the api prefix).

tags.name: Team Members
tags.description: Management of members within a team.

tags.name: Project Members
tags.description: Management of members within a project.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Task CRUD, assignment, status/priority, labels, subtasks and ordering.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregated dashboard for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns service status and runtime metadata. Public endpoint.

post.description: Creates a user account and returns the user together with a freshly generated API token.
Validates credentials and returns the user together with a fresh API token.
Revokes the current user's API token.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's own profile fields.

post.description: Changes the authenticated user's password after verifying the current password.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users, optionally filtered by a search term matching name or email.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term matched against name and email.

patch.description: Updates a user. Requires the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a user. Requires the admin role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of teams the authenticated user belongs to.

post.description: Invites a user (by email) to the team with the given role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the team's projects visible to the authenticated user.
Returns a paginated, filterable and sortable list of tasks in the project.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: When true, only top-level tasks (no parent) are returned.

post.description: Replaces the set of labels attached to the task.
Creates a task whose parent is the given task.
Moves the task to the given position within its list.

file.description: The file to attach. Maximum size 20 MB (20480 KB).

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: When true, only unread notifications are returned.

200.description: Number of notifications marked as read.

get.description: Returns a paginated global activity feed scoped to the authenticated user's teams and projects, with optional filters.
Returns aggregated data for the authenticated user: tasks by status, upcoming tasks, overdue count and recent activity.
Searches projects, tasks and comments visible to the authenticated user.

bearerAuth.description: API token obtained from register/login, sent as an Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Number of items per page (1-100, default 20).

NoContent.description: The request succeeded and there is no response body.

Unauthorized.description: The request lacks valid authentication credentials.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not authorized to perform this action.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

ActivityLogCollection.description: Paginated list of activity log entries.

MessageResponse.description: Generic message wrapper used for error responses.

PaginatedCollection.description: Base envelope for paginated Laravel resource collections.

User.description: A user account. The email field is only present when the authenticated user is viewing their own record or is an admin.

TeamRole.description: Role of a member within a team.

TeamMember.description: A membership linking a user to a team with a role.

Project.description: A project belonging to a team.

ProjectRole.description: Role of a member within a project.

ProjectMember.description: A membership linking a user to a project with a role.

ProjectStats.description: Aggregated project statistics. Exact shape is computed dynamically by the service. TODO: enumerate concrete fields.

Task.description: A task, including its description and relations.

TaskListItem.description: A lighter task representation used in listings; omits the description field.

Attachment.description: A file attached to a task.

Dashboard.description: Aggregated dashboard payload for the authenticated user.

my_tasks_by_status.description: Count of the user's assigned tasks per status.

SearchResults.description: Search results grouped by entity type.

AuthResponse.description: The authenticated user and their API token.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Fields the authenticated user may update on their own profile.

new_password.description: Must differ from the current password.

label_ids.description: The complete set of label ids to attach to the task.
